author: Nellyslife
title: HIRING: Freelance Illustrator & Graphic Designer (Philippines)
content: HIRING: Freelance Illustrator & Graphic Designer (Philippines). Remote · Project-based · Start ASAP. Apply by email only: team.nellyslife@gmail.com. Send your portfolio, rates and availability, with the subject line “Freelance Illustrator / Designer – [Your Name]”. DMs and comments won’t be considered. Please read the requirements in the graph below BEFORE applying to this job. Overview: We are seeking a versatile Illustrator to join our team on a contract basis. This role will involve creating high-quality designs for our products. Key Details: Remote Work Setup Minimum of 1 to 3 months, with the possibility of renewal. Starting at Php 35,000 for the first month, with the potential to increase to Php 45,000. Responsibilities: Create a number of high-quality small designs per week based on provided concept statements and your own creative ideas. Collaborate with the team. Review feedback and make necessary adjustments. Attached Reference: https://heyzine.com/flip-book/f88cd30909.html#page/1

author: Hoon Kim
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator. We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds. Quality level matching the attached characters. Requirements: - Japanese anime art style (see attached images) - Experience with 2D game character art - Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors) - work needs to match the quality of the attached examples (especially the coloring). To apply: Send your portfolio. Feel free to reach out!
